from makoto.registry import Check


def _budget(ctx):
    n = getattr(ctx, "retries", 0)
    return None if n < 3 else f"retried {n} times"


retry_CHECK = Check(id="gate.retry_budget", applies_at="Stop", posture="BLOCK",
                    run=lambda ctx=None: None)
CHECK = retry_CHECK
